title: Detailed crystal ball
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='ballGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c9f7ff'/>
      <stop offset='35%' stop-color='#5fd8f5'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#2a8fd4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7b57d6'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glowGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#aef4ff' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#aef4ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- inner glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='36' fill='url(#glowGrad)'/>

  <!-- glass sphere -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='30' fill='url(#ballGrad)'/>

  <!-- interior mist swirls -->
  <path d='M30 40 Q40 30 52 38 Q64 46 58 54 Q50 62 40 56 Q33 51 38 44' fill='none' stroke='#d8fbff' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-opacity='0.75' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 36 Q70 44 64 52 Q58 58 66 62' fill='none' stroke='#bff2ff' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-opacity='0.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='52' rx='9' ry='3.5' fill='#e8fdff' fill-opacity='0.45' transform='rotate(-20 46 52)'/>

  <!-- tiny sparkles inside -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='33' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='47' r='1.3' fill='#eaffff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#eaffff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='33' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- main specular highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='31' rx='8' ry='5.5' fill='#ffffff' fill-opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-25 41 31)'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='24' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff' fill-opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- rim light lower right -->
  <path d='M70 56 Q66 64 58 70' fill='none' stroke='#9ee6ff' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-opacity='0.7' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- base ring -->
  <path d='M26 68 Q50 78 74 68 L72 73 Q50 84 28 73 Z' fill='#3fb0c9'/>
  <path d='M26 68 Q50 78 74 68' fill='none' stroke='#7fe3f7' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- pedestal -->
  <path d='M34 73 L38 88 Q50 93 62 88 L66 73 Q50 80 34 73 Z' fill='#7b57d6'/>
  <path d='M38 88 Q50 93 62 88' fill='none' stroke='#a98bf0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 79 Q50 83 60 79' fill='none' stroke='#a98bf0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-opacity='0.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 89 Q50 96 70 89 L70 92 Q50 99 30 92 Z' fill='#5a3db0'/>
  <path d='M30 89 Q50 96 70 89' fill='none' stroke='#9c7ce8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
